summary: Amylyx filed an 8-K reporting two supply arrangements for avexitide drug substance: a Manufacturing and Supply Agreement with Bachem Americas, Inc. dated September 8, 2026, and a term sheet with Polypeptide Group AG dated September 1, 2026. Bachem and Polypeptide would be non-exclusive commercial suppliers if avexitide is approved, with minimum annual purchase commitments beginning 2028, a five-year initial term auto-renewing for three-year periods, annual price adjustments, and a $30 million upfront capacity-reservation fee to Polypeptide. This is a routine supply contract, not a special situation; no equity, deal terms, board recommendation, or arbitrage angle apply.
